description: A React component for user profile management, including profile picture upload, name editing, and logout functionality, utilizing Material UI components and custom hooks.

methods.name: handleSaveName
methods.description: Saves the updated user name if it is within max length and different from current.

methods.name: handleOpenImageDialog
methods.description: Opens the dialog to change or add a profile picture.

methods.name: handleCloseImageDialog
methods.description: Closes the profile picture change dialog.

methods.name: handleSaveImageLink
methods.description: Saves a profile picture URL if valid, updating user profile.

methods.name: handleFileUpload
methods.description: Handles image file upload, cropping, compressing, and saving to DB.

methods.name: handleDeleteImage
methods.description: Deletes the profile picture from DB and updates user profile.
